fields.notes: MODBUS Application Protocol V1.1b3 (2012) predates the standardization of MODBUS security extensions and contains no confidentiality, integrity, authentication, or access-control mechanisms. PDUs travel in cleartext; no signing; no client authentication; no replay protection. Practical deployments mitigate via network segmentation, VPN, IPsec, or application-layer firewalls. The dedicated 'MODBUS/TCP Security' specification (post-2018) introduces TLS encapsulation on a separate TCP port (typically 802) but is outside V1.1b3 scope.
